## C. The growth signal (arithmetic mixed stream, pool recipe, reservoir 20,000; 3 seeds)

Relative gap = (honest prequential loss - loss on replayed stored samples) / prequential loss, last 100 batches. Paired shadow trial = control against a clone widened to twice its width, trained on the same next batches, honest prequential loss per batch; gain = relative loss reduction of the shadow, positive = shadow better.

## C2. Which gap is a robust capacity signal? (last 100 of 900 batches, 3 seeds, mean (min-max))

(a) replay gap = (prequential - replay-sample loss) / prequential; (c) recent gap = (prequential - loss on the previous 8 batches) / prequential; (b) within-batch gap = (prequential - loss on the same batch after its 5 steps) / prequential.
